candidates.title: Wavy ocean in aerial photography
candidates.author: John Lockwood
candidates.notes: Turquoise water with white wave lines. Portrait original: a landscape cover crop from the lower half gives dark clear water behind the clock; avoid top foam under white text. Best if wanting saturated iPad-style nature color.

candidates.title: Mountain landscape with a calm lake at dawn
candidates.author: Wolfgang Hasselmann
candidates.notes: Quiet layered blue mountain silhouettes and peach sky. Portrait original; landscape crop should use center at about 65% image height to keep the lake and mountains. White text needs slight local shadow or lockscreen dimming. Recommended for restrained aesthetic.

candidates.title: A Sunrise Undercast
candidates.author: Balazs Busznyak
candidates.notes: Landscape original, cloud sea with peach dawn above; clean muted large color areas. Straight cover crop is safe, but default white clock needs a subtle dark lockscreen overlay because the upper sky is bright.
